extraction: UEViewer PNG export of the referenced Texture objects; original resolution, no repainting or resampling.
notes: Clothing icons follow the actual icon_ref stored in wardrobe_source.json, including retained full-body items.
Shared client references intentionally share a Texture2D across equipment variants.
Potion and fictional Grelim fang retain the existing game UI artwork. Skill and potion hotbar artwork is unchanged.

display_backgrounds.method: Shared-background color samples and border-connected masks; original PNG files are unchanged. Display textures replace only masked background pixels with a uniform rarity color matching the slot, and are cached by icon and rarity.
